m. (-ष्मः)
1 The hot season, (June and July.)
2 Spring, (April and May.)
3

Anger, warmth of temper.
5 Ardor, eagerness.
E.
उष to burn, मक् affix; also with कन् affix उष्मक, also उष्ण and उष्णक.

m. (-ष्मा)
1 The hot season.
2 Heat.
E.
उष to burn, and मनिन् aff.

m. (-पाः)
A heavenly spirit of an inferior order.

m. (-भाः)
The sun.
E.
उष्म and भास् what shines.

m. (-दः)
A vapour bath.
E.
उष्ण and स्वेद sweat.

m. (-मः)
The hot season: see उष्णागम.
